Android 12 + monitors app-derived subprocesses and may terminate PRoot, compiler, or Agent tasks after the system limit is exceeded.The child process limit is lifted here, not the number of Java/Kotlin threads.

MCP is an open standard model context protocol.After opening, Taihui will start the corresponding Stdio service or connect the local SSE endpoint in the PRoot sandbox, and dynamically inject professional tool capabilities into the intelligent agent.
Taihui will start the front desk service and hold the CPU process lock during Agent execution, but the system battery optimization may still be behind the screen.

WanXiang supports multiple Linux systems side by side. Every system automatically mounts the /workspace projects; /sdcard external storage is injected according to the toggles in Storage Mounts & Sharing. Each distro keeps its own package manager and software ecosystem fully isolated.
You have not configured any model archives, you can add Claude, OpenAI or DeepSeek → models by going to [Setting up model archive management]

Mounts only affect processes inside the Linux sandbox (terminal, agent, builds and background services), not the file explorer, which always accesses host storage directly. Mounts are injected at session startup; only new terminals and builds pick up changes. Full read-write access additionally requires the "All files access" permission in system settings.
